public.update_updated_at_column.definition:
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.update_updated_at_column()
 RETURNS trigger
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SET search_path TO 'public'
AS $function$ BEGIN NEW.updated_at = now(); RETURN NEW; END; $function$;

public.fn_ledger_append_only.definition:
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.fn_ledger_append_only()
 RETURNS trigger
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public'
AS $function$
BEGIN
  RAISE EXCEPTION 'estoque_movimentacoes e append-only: % nao permitido', TG_OP
    USING ERRCODE = '42501';
END;
$function$;
